summary: Compares Vela memory requirements and estimated inference time for one existing quantized TFLite or TOSA model across candidate Ethos-U accelerator, system, and memory configurations, using size and performance optimisation builds, without installing anything.
verification: Require every Vela invocation to succeed within one shared compilation deadline. Confirm that each build produces a Vela summary CSV; stop the complete process on the first failure.
Run `python <skill-dir>/scripts/evaluate_ethos_u_variants.py --help` to verify the runner interface.
Run the script with a representative quantized model and confirm four default build directories, `comparison.md`, and `comparison.csv` are produced.
Run it with a nonexistent model and confirm it reports `ERROR` and exits before invoking Vela.
Run it with a Git LFS pointer and confirm it reports missing model content and exits before invoking Vela.
Use `vela --list-configs Arm/vela.ini` only as a read-only check of the installed generic reference configurations.
stop_conditions: Ask for the model path when it is absent; do not select or download a model.

Return `FAIL` and stop when the model is missing, unreadable, represented only by a Git LFS pointer, or has another extension; when `vela` is unavailable or cannot report its version; when the selected configuration cannot be read; when the shared deadline expires; when a Vela compile fails; or when a summary CSV is absent or incomplete.
Stop the complete process on the first failure.
Do not continue with remaining candidates or optimization settings after a fatal error. Preserve the failed build's `vela.log` when an output directory has already been created.
Do not overwrite a non-empty user-selected output directory.
Do not install, update, or repair Vela, Python, models, or configuration files. Do not access the network.

rules.delta: Report only values read from Vela's generated summary CSV and console output. Do not infer successful NPU placement or missing measurements.
